about: Read by tools/coop_coverage_check.py. A verdict records what an item IS (port, engine-local, diagnostic, acu-only), never permission to skip it. 'behaviour' lists the findings that show what the item does; 'fields' and 'handler' override the tool-derived evidence with a finding ID when no tool output covers the item. 'trace' points to a saved two-game testbed trace (local, not distributed).
